messages:
vikram: FYI planning a short maintenance tonight 00:30-01:30 UTC for a coordinated NIC firmware retry across two racks. will do rolling reboots + brief cordon. trying to avoid impacting Dedicated pools.

sara: +1. which racks/regions? estimated capacity hit?

vikram: racks: saturn-21 and saturn-22 (us-west2). expected lost GPU capacity ~8% for ~30m during warmbackfill. we'll stagger to keep tail latencies stable.

chris: timeline? can we do staggered node reboots with 5m gaps and kv-cache preseed after each reboot? that helped last time.

vikram: plan: drain node -> soft reboot -> nvlink sanity -> kv-preseed -> uncordon. 5m gap between nodes; target window 00:30-01:30. will run 2 parallel streams (one per rack) but never same AZ host group.

jen: runbook clear? I can own canaries and rollback. would like an alert if error-rate + latency spike > 2x baseline for 10m.

vikram: yep will push runbook to /runbooks/infra/nic-fw-retry.md and set autosnooze on low-sev alerts. ops-bot: create incident stub and page if thresholds hit.

ops-bot: Incident stub created: INC-20231107-1709876543. Paging policy: oncall-eng -> oncall-sre if >10% error-rate.

sara: cost question — any billing exposure for Dedicated customers during warmbackfill? might want to notify top-tier tenants.

chris: we throttle spot eviction and prefer burst capacity fallback (from gradient pool) — billing unaffected but performance could be degraded. Recommend tenant comm for >95th percentile SLA customers.

vikram: agree. jen please own tenant comm for top 5 tenants; use template in #customer-success. brief + expected window + mitigation steps.

jen: will send comm now and schedule a follow-up if rollback occurs. LGTM on timeline.

sara: minor nit: add a short test checklist after each node: `nvidia-smi`, `dmesg | tail -n50`, `nvlink-health check`, and run a 3-min perf probe against seeded kv-cache.

vikram: added to runbook. also enabling quiet-window scheduling so scheduled jobs won't start heavy batch work during window.

chris: can we also patch the scheduling policy to avoid scheduling new long seq requests to these racks for 1h post-maint? prevents cold-cache storms.

vikram: yes — adding a route-table entry to mark racks as `gradual-backoff=1h` for scheduler. ops-bot: apply tag once maintenance starts.

ops-bot: Tag command queued: `tag-rack saturn-21 saturn-22 maintenance=1709876543` executed at start time.

jen: I'll watch canaries and post updates here every 10m. ty all.

sara: thanks. will standby for rollback signal.

vikram: rolling in at 00:30 UTC. posting a short postmortem link in this thread after the window. :thumbsup:
